entities.summary: Natalia Oleksiyivna Mohylevska, née Mohyla, also known by her stage name Nataliya Mogilevskaya, is a Ukrainian singer, songwriter, composer, Actor and TV presenter, producer. National Artist of Ukraine (2004).
